 Description
The Mitutoyo ARK-600 Hardness Tester is a reliable and efficient instrument used for measuring the hardness of various materials. It is equipped with a total test force of 588.4N (60kgf), 980.7N (100kgf), and 1471N (60-100-150kgf), ensuring accurate and consistent results. Additionally, it features a preliminary test force of N 98.07 kgf 10, further enhancing the precision of the measurements. With its high-quality design and functionality, the Mitutoyo ARK-600 Hardness Tester is a valuable tool for industries and laboratories that require precise hardness testing. Order# 810-218.
